items.title: 深夜のタクシーで乗客が感染者か見きわめ，送り届けた先で降ろすか射殺する。「WHERE TO?」の舞台は誰も信じられない街［BIC2026］
items.summary: ホラーゲーム「WHERETO?」が，釜山で開催中のインディーゲームイベント「BIC2026」に出展されていた。深夜の街でタクシーを運転し，乗せた客が感染者かどうかを見きわめ，送り届けた先で降ろすか射殺するかを判断するという，ダークな雰囲気の作品だ。

zh.title: 他们确定深夜出租车上的乘客是否被感染，然后要么让他们下车，要么在目的地将他们枪杀。 “去哪里？”故事发生在一座无人相信的城市 [BIC2026]
zh.summary: 恐怖游戏《WHERETO》在釜山举办的独立游戏盛会“BIC2026”上展出。这是一款黑暗氛围的作品，玩家在半夜驾驶出租车，判断自己搭载的乘客是否被感染，并决定是让他们下车还是在目的地将他们枪杀。

en.title: They determine if a passenger in a late-night taxi is infected, and either drop them off or shoot them dead at the destination. “WHERE TO?” is set in a city that no one can believe [BIC2026]
en.summary: The horror game ``WHERETO?'' was exhibited at the indie game event ``BIC2026'' being held in Busan. This is a work with a dark atmosphere in which the player drives a taxi in the middle of the night, determines whether the passengers he picks up are infected, and decides whether to drop them off or shoot them dead at the destination.

items.title: 漫画に取り込まれた漫画家を操作するホラーゲーム「Yūrei」。前のページに戻って描き直せば，その先の道が変わる［BIC2026］
items.summary: 韓国・釜山で開催されたインディーゲームイベント「BusanIndieConnectFestival2026」で，フランスのチームが「Yūrei」のデモ版を出展していた。プレイヤーが操作するのは，自分の描いた漫画に取り込まれた漫画家だ。ページを行き来して過去の場面を描き直しながら，未完の物語に決着をつけていく。

zh.title: 《Yūrei》是一款恐怖游戏，您可以控制在漫画中被捕获的漫画家。如果返回并重新绘制上一页，前面的路径将会改变[BIC2026]
zh.summary: 在韩国釜山举办的独立游戏盛会“BusanIndieConnectFestival 2026”上，法国团队展示了《Yūrei》的试玩版。玩家控制一名漫画家，该漫画家已融入他或她所绘制的漫画中。通过在页面之间来回翻阅并重新绘制过去的场景，未完成的故事得到了结论。

en.title: ``Yūrei'' is a horror game where you control a manga artist who has been captured in a manga. If you go back and redraw the previous page, the path ahead will change [BIC2026]
en.summary: At the indie game event "BusanIndieConnectFestival 2026" held in Busan, South Korea, a French team exhibited a demo version of "Yūrei". The player controls a manga artist who has been incorporated into the manga he or she has drawn. By going back and forth between pages and redrawing past scenes, the unfinished story is brought to a conclusion.

items.title: 開発者育成の拠点は，首都ジャカルタではなくバンドン。インドネシア通信・デジタル省とBICが2027年1月から共同事業を実施［BIC2026］
items.summary: BIC2026の会場に，インドネシア共和国通信・デジタル省（Komdigi）の担当者が来ていた。約200社まで増えた同国のゲームスタジオの現状，そしてインドネシアでゲームを出すために今なにが要るのかが説明された。

zh.title: 开发商的发展基地是万隆，而不是首都雅加达。印度尼西亚通信和数字部与 BIC 将从 2027 年 1 月起开展联合项目 [BIC2026]
zh.summary: 印度尼西亚共和国通信和数字部 (Komdigi) 的代表出席了 BIC2026 会场。他解释了该国游戏工作室的现状（已增加到约200家公司），以及现在在印尼发行游戏需要什么。

en.title: The base for developing developers is Bandung, not the capital Jakarta. Indonesian Ministry of Communications and Digital and BIC will carry out joint project from January 2027 [BIC2026]
en.summary: A representative from the Ministry of Communications and Digital of the Republic of Indonesia (Komdigi) was at the BIC2026 venue. He explained the current situation of game studios in the country, which have increased to about 200 companies, and what is needed now to release games in Indonesia.

items.summary: 韓国・釜山で開催された「BIC2026」の会場で，寂れた街を探索する見下ろし視点のアクションアドベンチャー「Rustown」を体験した。プレイヤーには攻撃手段が一切ない。道を進むには，さまざまなルートを見つけ，必要なアイテムを集めていくことになる。

en.title: ``Rustown'' is a story about a young girl who travels through the slums left behind by a virus that erodes her intelligence in search of her father. Immersive story action where you can't hit back even if you get hit [BIC2026]
en.summary: At the "BIC2026" venue held in Busan, South Korea, I experienced "Rustown," an action adventure from a top-down perspective that explores a deserted town. Players have no means of attack. To advance on the path, you will need to find various routes and collect the necessary items.

items.title: 1か月先の計画は立てない。ダークな童話世界のローグライトアクション「Cinderia」を作るMyACG Studioは，アイデアを2時間で遊べる形にする［BIC2026］

zh.title: 不要提前一个月制定计划。 MyACG Studio 创造了黑暗童话世界中的 Rogue-lite 动作游戏《灰姑娘》，在两个小时内将一个想法变成了可玩的形式 [BIC2026]

en.title: From Xbox to PS5: The evolution of the original Halo
en.summary: In 2001, the original "Halo" was released on the Xbox console, setting the standard for console first-person shooter games. In 2011, "Halo: 10th Anniversary Edition" was released on the Xbox 360 console. It was a replica full of flaws. In order to make up for the shortcomings, players relied on their own efforts and serially updated the "SPV3" replica campaign MOD with richer content from 2012 to 2019. On July 28, 2026, "Halo: Battle Evolved" was officially released on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series S/X. This time it was reprinted using Unreal Engine 5. "Campaign Evolved" is the first time the "Halo" series has landed on Sony's console platform. It is also the game with the best graphics and the most auxiliary function options in the series. Whether you are an old player who has persisted from the original "Halo" or a new player who is coming into contact with the series for the first time, "Campaign Evolved" is a masterpiece worth trying. ■
